mainEntity.name: How many revisions till satisfied?

acceptedAnswer.text: Infinite revisions. We iterate continuously on every draft, technical guide, and code repository until your team is 100% satisfied with prose clarity, technical accuracy, and execution benchmarks.

mainEntity.name: How are the payments handled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Payments are handled by milestones, with every milestone having equal weightage on the final product. Whether split 50/50 for articles or 33/33/34 across multi-part suites, every phase carries equal weight.

mainEntity.name: Who owns the intellectual property and copyright?

acceptedAnswer.text: You retain 100% full IP ownership and copyright upon completion. All technical guides, notebooks, and sample code are delivered directly under your organization's open-source or proprietary licensing terms.

mainEntity.name: How is code execution and quantum circuit accuracy verified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every code snippet, API request, PyTorch pipeline, and Qiskit quantum circuit is manually executed and verified in isolated virtual environments or simulator/hardware backends before publishing. No unverified boilerplate.

mainEntity.name: What is Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) / Country Parity Pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: PPP pricing ensures equal access for engineering teams globally. Clients in Tier 2 Developing Nations get 25% off (75% price) and Tier 3 Least Developed Nations get 50% off (50% price) based on World Bank indices.

mainEntity.name: Is there a special discount for early-stage startups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Pre-Seed and Seed-stage startups receive a prominent 50% discount across all technical content packages to accelerate developer acquisition during crucial launch windows.

mainEntity.name: What technology stacks and frameworks do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative AI (PyTorch, vLLM, Ollama, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude, Gemini APIs), Quantum Computing (IBM Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq), and Core Systems (Python and Rust).

mainEntity.name: What is the typical turnaround time for a deliverable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Short technical articles take 3–5 business days; standard deep dives take 5–8 business days; full developer documentation suites take 14–21 business days.

mainEntity.name: Do you sign Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. Standard mutual NDAs are executed prior to examining unreleased API endpoints, proprietary SDKs, or pre-launch model architecture documentation.

mainEntity.name: Can you write for both developers and executive leaders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Using the Diátaxis framework, content is structured with modular sections: quickstarts for busy engineers, benchmark deep dives for researchers, and executive summaries for decision-makers.

mainEntity.name: In what file formats do you deliver content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clean Markdown (.md), MDX, Jupyter Notebooks (.ipynb), executable Python/Qiskit scripts, OpenAPI/Swagger JSON specs, and direct GitHub Pull Requests to your repository.

mainEntity.name: How does AI acceleration work with 100% human verification?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frontier AI tools accelerate research aggregation and initial outline drafting. Every line of prose and code is then hand-written, manually tested, and line-by-line verified by Thomas Cherickal.

mainEntity.name: How do you cover Quantum Machine Learning (QML) and hybrid algorithms?

acceptedAnswer.text: We author end-to-end technical guides covering Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs), Quantum Kernel Methods, and Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQE/QAOA) executed via PennyLane and IBM Qiskit Aer.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer monthly content partner retainers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Monthly retainer partnerships provide dedicated sprint capacity for technical articles, changelogs, SDK update guides, and continuous documentation maintenance.

mainEntity.name: What happens if an API version changes shortly after delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor code snippet updates and API breaking change patches are included free for 60 days post-launch under our commitment to long-term content accuracy.

mainEntity.name: How do we get started on a project brief?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit your requirements via the brief form on contact.html. We return a clear milestone scope proposal within 24 hours.

mainEntity.name: Can you author reproducible benchmark comparison reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Standalone benchmarking passes include a dedicated GitHub repository with reproducible scripts for throughput, latency, memory utilization, and accuracy metrics.

mainEntity.name: How are quantum algorithms verified on hardware?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quantum circuits are validated first on statevector simulators (Qiskit Aer / PennyLane), followed by noisy simulation models and execution on IBM Quantum hardware backend channels.

mainEntity.name: Do you support multi-language documentation translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary content is authored in clear US English, structured semantically with clean HTML/Markdown for translation support.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods do you accept internationally?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept International Wire Transfer (SWIFT), PayPal, and Direct Bank Transfers for seamless global settlement.
